Glossary / Settlement (T+1)
Glossary · Indian market

Settlement (T+1) सेटलमेंट (T+1)

The process of transferring shares and money after a trade. In India, equity trades settle one trading day after the trade (T+1).

हिंदी में: सेटलमेंट (T+1)

ट्रेड के बाद शेयर और पैसे का हस्तांतरण। भारत में इक्विटी ट्रेड अगले ट्रेडिंग दिन (T+1) सेटल होते हैं।

How it is used in the lessons

Settlement is the process that moves the shares and the money.

From Stock Market Foundations

Indian equities settle on T+1: one trading day after the trade date.

From Market Rules & Investor Protection

Indian equities settle on T+1, so the ex-date and the record date now fall on the same day.

From Corporate Actions: Dividends, Bonus, Splits, Rights and Buybacks
